tools.name: init
tools.description: Create a case at path with a title, domain and actor label.

tools.name: put
tools.description: Add or revise an evidence-linked case item; supply expected_version and expected_deps for guarded concurrent writes.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read the current case state.

tools.name: review
tools.description: Record an item review with a verdict and reason.

tools.name: approval_challenge
tools.description: Return canonical bytes for offline Ed25519 signing of an exact normative item revision.

tools.name: approve
tools.description: Record a normative approval; signed cases require a trusted Ed25519 signature.

tools.name: test_execution_challenge
tools.description: Return canonical bytes for offline Ed25519 signing of an external test execution report. No command is run.

tools.name: record_test_execution
tools.description: Record a signed external test report for the current test revision. No command is run.

tools.name: test_observation_challenge
tools.description: Return canonical bytes for offline Ed25519 signing of an external test observation receipt. No command is run.

tools.name: record_test_observation
tools.description: Record a signed external observation for the current test execution. No command is run.

tools.name: field_attestation_challenge
tools.description: Prepare case, item and source hashes for an independent field assessor's Ed25519 signature.

tools.name: attest_field
tools.description: Record a signed assessor statement. It does not unblock a decisive field verdict.

tools.name: challenge
tools.description: Record a contradiction between two items.

tools.name: resolve_challenge
tools.description: Resolve a contradiction using an existing resolution item.

tools.name: gate
tools.description: Evaluate the requirements for advancing a phase without changing state.

tools.name: phase_review_challenge
tools.description: Return canonical bytes for offline Ed25519 signing of a phase review of the current snapshot.

tools.name: review_phase
tools.description: Record a phase review; signed cases require a trusted Ed25519 reviewer signature.

tools.name: advance
tools.description: Advance the requested phase only when the engine gate permits it.

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Trace an item to its referenced inputs and dependents.

tools.name: next_task
tools.description: Get bounded, versioned instructions for the next pending workflow task.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Apply a schema 1 workflow manifest; pause at human approval or independent review.

tools.name: audit_lot_journal
tools.description: Audit declared incremental lot balances and wet/dry mass basis; no field authenticity or acceptance is established. Read-only, no case required.
